name: QOBLIB ten-asset portfolio: close the exact optimum gap for a010_t10_orig_b004_l1e-03
compute_profile: laptop-hours to laptop-days; 10 assets, 10 periods, 600 position binaries before presolve, plus 110 slack bits; exploit interchangeable unit copies and the four-position budget
statement: Thorsten Koch and colleagues’ Quantum Optimization Benchmarking Library publishes a multi-period Markowitz benchmark with transaction costs, cash interest and short positions. On 2026-10-24 the portfolio table labels a010_t10_orig_b004_l1e-03 best known with incumbent -8397. Maximilian Schicker’s 2025-08-19 submission reports -8397 and numerical bound -15342.65126758 after 3600.03 seconds; that bound is not an exact proof. The canonical schedule file repeats instance po_a010_t10_orig, budget 4, lambda 0.001 and objective -8397. Fix the shipped rounded integer-coefficient BQP, dataset po_a010_t10_orig, a=10, t=10, B=4 and lambda=1/1000; keep the other parameter_u3_c10.zpl settings, including unit=100000, cash=1000000, ub=3, delta=0.001, nu=0.0001, rho=0.000025 and upscale=1. There are three interchangeable copies per asset, direction and period, plus four-bit cash and seven-bit budget slack registers. The exact global optimum remains unproved in the source table.
success_criterion: Give a globally optimal feasible position schedule for this exact instance, its integer objective v <= -8397, and an independently checkable matching lower-bound certificate. A solution equal to -8397 is a full win only with an exact global optimality certificate. Certificates may be a complete dynamic-programming/Bellman certificate or an exact rational branch-and-bound proof for the published BQP; a solver status or floating-point gap alone does not qualify.

partial_wins.statement: An explicit feasible canonical schedule with recomputed integer objective at most -8398, strictly improving the published -8397 incumbent, even without proving optimality. Also strictly improve the best comparable published result at claim time, including compatible compositions of published objects. State whether the candidate is a composition and identify its components. Values in unmerged pull requests do not set the bar.

verification_method: Read the original price and covariance decimal strings as rationals. Reproduce the coefficients of bqp_u3_c10.zpl using Zimpl round-half-away-from-zero, at the same places as the model. Check every unit count is an integer in 0..3, per-period total count <=4, cash slack 10-net in 0..15 and budget slack 4-total in 0..127. Reconstruct canonical copy slots, slack bits and the complete objective, including initial purchases, final liquidation and the model's actual indexing/multiplicities. Cross-check with the public exact Rust checker. For optimality, enumerate per-period count states and verify all Bellman lower-bound inequalities and a matching attaining path. There are 10606 count states before any additional pruning: 20 direction/asset counts in 0..3 with total <=4. Direct comparisons are about a billion small integer operations; a certified weighted-L1 distance transform can reduce this substantially. A verifier should take minutes to hours in compiled code.
status_checked: 2026-10-24 (live best-known status, submission gap, canonical schedule header and model definitions confirmed)
angles: Use long/short unit counts, not permutations of the three identical copies. The source checker explains why canonical aligned slots preserve the optimum.

Build an exact dynamic program over daily states. Transaction costs are weighted absolute count changes; shortest-path distance transforms on the count-state graph may avoid an all-pairs transition loop.
Use the -8397 schedule as a reproducibility check before searching. Optimize the rounded shipped objective, with its exact boundary terms.
pitfalls: The source table is not an optimality certificate. Likewise the reported Gurobi lower bound is floating-point evidence, not a proof.
The high-level README simplifies the model. The Zimpl source and parameter file define the actual instance, including any repeated summands; do not silently repair the economics.
Long and short holdings in the same asset are not forbidden by the published constraints. Adding that prohibition changes the benchmark.
The time-index convention matters: price data and objective return/liquidation indices must follow the source exactly.
QOBLIB has a live solver/submission table, so the bank's commit-only disclosure rule is selected. This proposal authorizes no submission or contact.
